capabilities: Take photos and video recordings with the device camera
Insert links to the recording into the open markdown file
Browse saved recordings with a file picker
extras: README states the software is in Beta and may have issues on some systems, especially mobile devices; it was built primarily for Obsidian desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture photos or video from a camera directly into the vault and link them in a note.
summary: Camera plugin that takes photos and video recordings from the device camera and saves them into the vault.
